title: Baked Pesto Chicken Gnocchi
description: Everything goes into one dish: gnocchi, chicken, pesto, yoghurt and vegetables, baked under mozzarella. About two minutes of prep.

source.name: Firsttakehadrian (Instagram)
source.note: Hype or Hoax. Rated 8.5/10. Episode number and original title not captured; title here is descriptive.

confidence.note: Amounts as given in the creator's caption. The recipe title wasn't in the screenshot, so this one is descriptive. Not yet cooked and confirmed at home.

nutrition.note: As stated by the source (fibre estimated by the source); not independently checked.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Add the gnocchi ({{gnocchi}}), pesto ({{pesto}}), onion ({{onion}}), peas ({{peas}}), capsicum ({{capsicum}}), stock ({{stock}}), yoghurt ({{yoghurt}}), garlic ({{garlic}}), chicken ({{chicken}}), sun-dried tomatoes ({{sundried-tomatoes}}), spinach ({{spinach}}) and mozzarella ({{mozzarella}}) to a large baking dish and mix well.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until the chicken is cooked through and the cheese is golden.
